final: WITH pat AS (SELECT p.ID AS id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS m1, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS m2 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT sex, AVG(m1) AS a1, AVG(m2) AS a2 FROM pat GROUP BY sex), agg AS (SELECT AVG(a2) AS av FROM sx) SELECT AVG(sx.a1) AS avg_first, AVG(sx.a2) AS avg_second, AVG(sx.a2 - agg.av) AS avg_third FROM sx JOIN agg ON agg.av IS NOT NULL WHERE sx.a2 > agg.av
